<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/loads/{loadId}/cancellations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a `PLANNED` load to `CANCELLED` and publishes `LoadCancelled`.
Only a `PLANNED` load can be cancelled — a load already `LOADING`
must be resolved instead (short-ship and close, or reopen later): the
refusal is `409 load-state` (`ErrInvalidTransition`). A
`SHIP_CONFIRMED` load refuses with `409 load-confirmed`. The load's
state is checked before its packages: only a `PLANNED` load that
already has packages assigned refuses with `409 load-has-packages`
(short-ship and close instead).
